creative_direction: Photograph an original 32-year-old man with short slightly wavy hair, light natural stubble, and an attentive expression. Use a chest-up three-quarter pose, with his gaze just beside the camera. Dress him in a plain ink-blue buttoned shirt with the collar relaxed but neat. One broad window provides gentle side light, leaving a soft shadow across the far cheek. Set the background to muted stone gray and keep it empty. Emphasize believable skin, hair, and fabric instead of glossy retouching or fashion accessories. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
